rule: FREEZE_BLOCKED if any L3c/L3d engineering gate FAILs (label leak, invalid likelihood, broken invariance, budget breach).

FREEZE_KEYED iff L3c-1 PASS AND all three matched keyed runs complete AND keyed is not materially degraded on VALIDATION: (a) seed-averaged per-root validation root-NLL contrast keyed - unique has root-cluster 95% CI lower bound <= 0 (i.e. not significantly worse) AND (b) mean calibrated validation repair accuracy drop <= 0.03 AND (c) mean validation scene NLL increase <= 0.05. Rationale: the alias invariance is substantive (listing-dependent relations moved beliefs by up to 0.30 in C-full), not cosmetic, so a verified, non-degraded keyed model is the semantically correct freeze.
otherwise FREEZE_UNIQUE (ABC9U_UNIQUE_V1), documenting the remaining role sensitivities.

The disclosed P8c test never enters the rule. Checkpoint choice within the frozen family: lowest validation root NLL among its 3 seeds at the family's longest matched schedule (unique: 400 updates; keyed: 200 updates).

Visual features: DINOv2 stays ENABLED in the frozen model unless visual-zero is better on validation root NLL with a root-cluster CI excluding 0 AND sign-stable under leave-one-root-out (extraordinary evidence); the result is reported either way.
